title: HomeOps Repository Inventory
description: Schema for .inventory/repos.yaml — describes Git repositories managed by this home lab.

name.description: Short human-readable name for this repository.

url.description: Clone URL. Use HTTPS or SSH format. Do not commit tokens in the URL.

description.description: What this repository contains or manages.

deploy_host.description: Name of the node (from nodes.yaml) where this repo is checked out or deployed.

deploy_path.description: Filesystem path on deploy_host where the repo lives.

auto_pull.description: Whether a cron job or systemd timer automatically pulls updates.

branch.description: Default branch tracked on this host.
